name: Amity
source:
You wake up without memories in a submarine at the bottom of the ocean. Your only companion is the friendly Amity, but are they truly who they seem? How did you lose your memory? What happened to the rest of the crew?

[From [url=https://chetamashii.itch.io/amity]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在海底的一艘潜艇中醒来，失去了记忆。你唯一的同伴是友好的阿米提，但他们真的是表面上的那样吗？你是怎么失去记忆的？其余船员怎么样了？

[来自[url=https://chetamashii.itch.io/amity]Itch.io[/url]]
